historical_invariants: The composite golden contains 855 occurrences: 852 outer-manifest members, two separately evidenced manifests, and one external catalog.
All occurrences remain distinct even if future evidence reveals equal hashes.
The 200-candidate triage yields 199 usable base works and one excluded candidate.
The base catalog contains 221 cards; enrichment adds 71 and yields 292.
The enrichment queue and overlay set each contain 111 works; 88 base works have no overlay by design.
There are 12 ordered checkpoints and three revision patches keyed by evidence_id.
The package contains six payloads plus its manifest.
Historical proof never promotes unknown chronology or missing receipts to known facts.

known_gaps.impact: Nine web consultations have no complete local receipt.
Three historically manifested artifacts are restricted_local and absent from a Git-only checkout.
The global manifest omits both MANIFEST.json basenames; the composite golden closes this with separate evidence.
Uniform created_by_run_id is absent from historical records.
Reviewer is not recorded in the three-entry revision ledger; it remains null.
Remote retrieval and full human deliberation chronologies are not provable.

multiplicity.rule: Occurrences are never deduplicated by SHA-256; current golden set has zero equal-byte groups.
